verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device model, inference and fine-tuning platform, so an in-product assistant is a fair question, but no evidence shows a built-in assistant in its dashboard, CLI or platform that users can hand tasks to. The pack shows model demos (a browser demo of the Automation Foundation Model, an Android chat app showcasing the offline LLM) and support for driving the platform from an external coding agent with an API key. Neither is a built-in assistant for delegating work within the product.
